data.name: AIMX
data.detailed_description:
AimX is an easy to use aim trainer for players who want personalized and efficient training without having to research drills or build routines.

Your strengths, weaknesses and recent performance help AimX recommend relevant drills and adapt your training to your current needs to maximize efficiency.

Whether you want to improve over time, warm-up before playing or focus on a specific aim skill, AimX provides a clear way to train and measure your progress.

Spend less time planning your training and more time improving your aim.

Play & Improve System

An open adaptive training flow. AimX selects your next useful drill after every result.

Full Warm-Up System

A guided warm-up that adapts after every drill and moves you from 0% to 100% readiness before you play.

Control when you want it

Use adaptive flows when you want guidance or choose drills and routines manually when you already know what you need to train.
